title: Role Agent Enhancement — Dynamic Attributes + STM/LTM
description: Enhance the character agent with BookWorld's role agent pattern: separate static/dynamic attributes, open-domain natural language action space, and short-term + long-term memory with capacity limits and auto-abstraction. Integrate with lifecycle hooks from TASK-001.
action: Add dynamic attribute types to src-ts/narrative/character-depth.ts (goals, states evolving per scene). Add STM/LTM memory layer to src-ts/agents/character.ts using existing memory/six-dimensional-memory.ts infrastructure — STM stores recent events with capacity limit (default 20), overflow auto-abstracts to LTM via summarize(). Register perception and reflection lifecycle hooks for structured action generation. Add DynamicCharacterState interface.

convergence.verification: Import CharacterAgent, verify it has STM/LTM fields, addHook calls for perception and reflection. Create instance with mock data, push events to STM until capacity exceeded, verify overflow to LTM via summarization.
convergence.definition_of_done: Character agent separates static traits from dynamic evolving attributes. STM/LTM memory manages action history with auto-abstraction on overflow. Agent uses lifecycle hooks for structured reasoning.

files.change: Add DynamicCharacterState interface {goals: string[], currentStates: string[], recentActions: string[], lastUpdated: string}. Add function to update dynamic state from scene results.

Add private shortTermMemory: string[] with STM_CAPACITY=20. Add private longTermMemory: string[] for auto-abstracted summaries. Add pushMemory(event) method that appends to STM, on overflow calls summarize(oldest) and pushes summary to LTM. Register perception hook to gather context from STM+LTM. Register reflection hook to update dynamic attributes.
Add method to load dynamic state for a character, integrate with DynamicCharacterState from character-depth.ts

implementation: In src-ts/narrative/character-depth.ts: add DynamicCharacterState interface with goals: string[], currentStates: string[], recentActions: string[], lastUpdated: string. Add updateDynamicState(current: DynamicCharacterState, sceneResult: string): Promise<DynamicCharacterState> that uses LLM to extract goal/state changes from scene result.

In src-ts/agents/character.ts: add private shortTermMemory: string[] = [] field with const STM_CAPACITY = 20. Add private longTermMemory: string[] = [] field. Add pushMemory(event: string): void — pushes to STM, if STM.length > STM_CAPACITY, pop oldest, summarize via LLM, push summary to LTM. Add getMemoryContext(): string method returning combined STM + LTM summary for prompt injection.

In src-ts/agents/character.ts constructor or init: register perception lifecycle hook that assembles context from STM+LTM+dynamic state. Register reflection lifecycle hook that calls updateDynamicState and pushMemory with execution results.
In src-ts/narrative/cross-chapter-character-tracker.ts: add getDynamicState(characterId: string): Promise<DynamicCharacterState> method that loads or initializes dynamic state for a character.
Verify: cd src-ts && npx tsc --noEmit passes

commands: cd src-ts && npx vitest run tests/agents/character.test.ts tests/narrative/character-depth.test.ts
unit: pushMemory: events under capacity stay in STM only
pushMemory: exceeding capacity triggers summarization to LTM
getMemoryContext: returns combined STM + LTM content
Character agent with lifecycle hooks: perception hook assembles memory context
success_metrics: All existing character agent tests still pass

reference.pattern: BookWorld role agent: static attributes (unchanging) + dynamic attributes (goals/states evolving), STM with capacity limit + LTM via summarize()
reference.examples: six-dimensional-memory.ts already has layered memory concept — STM/LTM adds capacity management and auto-abstraction

rationale.chosen_approach: Layer STM/LTM on existing memory infrastructure rather than new memory system
decision_factors: BookWorld validates that STM+LTM with capacity limits improves character consistency
Integration with lifecycle hooks enables structured reasoning
rationale.tradeoffs: Tight coupling to six-dimensional-memory patterns, but avoids duplicating memory infrastructure

risks: STM_CAPACITY=20 is a starting default — may need tuning based on chapter length
